opportunities.title: Stelara-to-Tremfya/Icotyde conversion enablement
opportunities.what_happened: 2026 is the first full year of Stelara LOE, driving a ~43% sales collapse; J&J must convert prescribers to Tremfya and the newly approved oral Icotyde.
opportunities.evidence: 2026 first full year Stelara LOE embedded; biosimilars drove 43% collapse; Tremfya +68.3% Q1 2026; Icotyde approved as first IL-23 oral peptide for psoriasis.
opportunities.ai_hypothesis: The Stelara revenue hole forces accelerated share capture for replacement immunology assets, compressing launch timelines and raising the cost of any delay.
opportunities.so_what: Prescriber conversion is mission-critical, non-postponable defensive spend.
opportunities.why_it_matters_to_indegene: Switching campaigns need rapid MLR-cleared content, prescriber analytics and targeted omnichannel at scale — Company's DAAI/MLR/Omnichannel remit.
opportunities.next_best_action: Pitch a Stelara-to-Tremfya/Icotyde conversion program combining DAAI prescriber analytics with accelerated MLR and omnichannel sequencing.
opportunities.if_no_action: Every quarter of delay lets Stelara's biosimilar rivals harden their grip on the prescriber base. Conversion becomes a recapture problem J&J funds at higher cost, with the replacement assets carrying less momentum into their launch years.
opportunities.why_now: The 43% collapse is unfolding inside the current 2026 budget year, so conversion spend is being committed now rather than planned later.
opportunities.nba_outcome: A conversion program running that sequences prescriber analytics, accelerated MLR and omnichannel in one package.
opportunities.expected_outcome: Tremfya and Icotyde conversion rates among targeted Stelara prescribers tracked and reported each quarter.

opportunities.title: Full-funnel Icotyde first-in-class oral psoriasis launch
opportunities.what_happened: FDA approved Icotyde (icotrokinra), the first IL-23-targeted oral peptide for moderate-to-severe plaque psoriasis, superior to deucravacitinib in Phase 3.
opportunities.evidence: First and only IL-23-targeted oral peptide approved for moderate-to-severe plaque psoriasis; superior to deucravacitinib in Phase 3.
opportunities.ai_hypothesis: As first-in-class, Icotyde needs extensive first-line positioning education and a fresh omnichannel launch to establish share against injectables and orals.
opportunities.so_what: A brand-new oral immunology launch requires full commercialization build-out during the critical post-approval window.
opportunities.why_it_matters_to_indegene: End-to-end launch opportunity: omnichannel HCP engagement, MedComm and MLR at speed.
opportunities.next_best_action: Present a full-funnel Icotyde launch program covering omnichannel, MedComm and MLR.
opportunities.if_no_action: Icotyde's first-line positioning is set during a short post-approval window, and delay means injectable incumbents frame the category first. Company then misses the build-out that defines the brand's first two years.
opportunities.why_now: Approval is current, and the post-approval period is the only moment a full-funnel build-out is planned from scratch.
opportunities.nba_outcome: One full-funnel Icotyde launch program signed, spanning omnichannel, MedComm and MLR as a single scope.
opportunities.expected_outcome: Full-funnel assets cleared and live before the commercial push peaks, with first-line positioning claimed against injectable incumbents within the first two quarters.

opportunities.title: Portfolio commercialization capacity for the $100bn scale-up
opportunities.what_happened: J&J raised 2026 guidance to $101.1bn and is on track to cross $100bn annual revenue for the first time, scaling launches across immunology, oncology and MedTech simultaneously.
opportunities.evidence: Estimated reported sales $101.1bn (+7.3% midpoint); adjusted EPS raised to $11.68; on track for >$100bn for first time.
opportunities.ai_hypothesis: A multi-franchise scale-up creates pull for integrated capacity that flexes across therapeutic areas rather than being scoped per brand.
opportunities.so_what: Record revenue concentrates budget on sustaining launch momentum across the portfolio.
opportunities.why_it_matters_to_indegene: Position a portfolio-level omnichannel/MedComm/MLR capacity model that scales launches without linear headcount growth.
opportunities.next_best_action: Bring a portfolio-level commercialization-capacity proposal to Innovative Medicine and MedTech commercial ops.
opportunities.if_no_action: Capacity is bought franchise by franchise as each launch lands, so Company never holds a portfolio-level mandate inside a year that crosses $100B. The scale-up then compounds for whichever vendors took the integrated seat.
opportunities.why_now: Guidance at $101.1B for 2026 means commercial budgets are being set this cycle against a first-ever $100B year.
opportunities.nba_outcome: A portfolio-level capacity proposal accepted for discussion by Innovative Medicine and MedTech commercial ops.
opportunities.expected_outcome: Cross-franchise capacity committed, with launches across immunology, oncology and MedTech resourced under one flexible agreement.

opportunities.title: Concurrent-approval regulatory-ops and content-update partnership
opportunities.what_happened: J&J secured a dense 2026 approval cluster: TECVAYLI+DARZALEX FASPRO (RRMM 2L), monthly RYBREVANT FASPRO (EGFR NSCLC), CAPLYTA (adjunctive MDD).
opportunities.evidence: FDA approved TECVAYLI plus DARZALEX FASPRO for RRMM after at least one prior line; RYBREVANT FASPRO approved as once-monthly EGFR therapy.
opportunities.ai_hypothesis: Near-simultaneous label expansions strain internal regulatory and content teams, creating overflow demand.
opportunities.so_what: Concurrent approvals drive regulatory ops, submission support and MLR content updates.
opportunities.why_it_matters_to_indegene: Aligns with Company Regulatory and MLR service lines as an absorbable overflow-capacity engagement.
opportunities.next_best_action: Pitch a regulatory-operations and content-update capacity partnership to absorb the concurrent approval workload.
opportunities.if_no_action: Each approval finds its own content-update support, and J&J's internal teams absorb the spike with stretched timelines. Company then holds no regulatory-operations relationship when the next approval wave lands.
opportunities.why_now: The cluster is landing now, and the RRMM and NSCLC label changes create immediate regulatory and content deadlines in this cycle.
opportunities.nba_outcome: A capacity partnership that absorbs the approval-driven overflow across regulatory ops and content updates.
opportunities.expected_outcome: Label-change submissions and updated promotional materials delivered on time across the cluster, with capacity metering reported to J&J regulatory teams.

opportunities.title: OTTAVA surgeon-adoption and digital-training engagement
opportunities.what_happened: J&J received FDA De Novo authorization for the OTTAVA table-integrated robotic surgical system for ten general surgery procedures, challenging Intuitive's da Vinci.
opportunities.evidence: J&J's Ottava integrated-table motion is unique in surgical robotics; challenges Intuitive Surgical.
opportunities.ai_hypothesis: Entering robotics against an entrenched incumbent requires heavy surgeon education and change-management during the limited US launch.
opportunities.so_what: Adoption depends on winning over surgeons already trained on da Vinci — a high-touch education challenge.
opportunities.why_it_matters_to_indegene: Surgeon onboarding content, omnichannel HCP engagement and digital training span Omnichannel, MedComm and Tech Solutions.
opportunities.next_best_action: Propose a surgeon adoption and digital-training engagement for the OTTAVA limited US launch.
opportunities.if_no_action: da Vinci-trained surgeons default to their existing training and support relationships, and the OTTAVA conversion campaign starts late. Company then misses the adoption window that determines the platform's first-year footprint.
opportunities.why_now: De Novo authorization is fresh, so the limited U.S. launch is being planned in this cycle while surgeon mindshare is still unclaimed.
opportunities.nba_outcome: A surgeon adoption and digital-training engagement contracted for the limited U.S. launch.
opportunities.expected_outcome: Surgeon onboarding completed and adoption behavior tracked across the ten approved procedures, with training metrics reported to the OTTAVA launch team.

potential_missed_opportunities.title: MedTech commercial-modernization gap
potential_missed_opportunities.what_happened: MedTech grew only +3.6% operationally versus Innovative Medicine +6.8% in Q2 2026.
potential_missed_opportunities.ai_hypothesis: MedTech underperformance reflects competitive pressure and slower commercial digitization, opening the door to a transformation partner — a door Company may not currently occupy.
potential_missed_opportunities.so_what: MedTech leadership is under pressure to accelerate growth via modernized go-to-market.
potential_missed_opportunities.why_it_matters_to_indegene: If Company is absent from MedTech, a competitor may anchor the omnichannel/analytics modernization work; DAAI, Omnichannel and Tech Solutions apply directly.
potential_missed_opportunities.next_best_action: Approach MedTech commercial leadership with an omnichannel and analytics modernization proposal focused on surgeon and hospital engagement.
potential_missed_opportunities.if_no_action: A competitor that moved early defines MedTech's modernization agenda, and Company's late bid is measured against that incumbent's frame. Each quarter MedTech trails Innovative Medicine widens the gap Company would have helped close.
potential_missed_opportunities.why_now: MedTech's 3.6% print versus Innovative Medicine's 6.8% is the current mandate, and transformation partners get selected against it this cycle.
potential_missed_opportunities.nba_outcome: MedTech modernization scope initiated with Company before a competitor's framework becomes the default.
potential_missed_opportunities.expected_outcome: Surgeon and hospital engagement modernization running under Company, with go-to-market metrics tracked against MedTech's growth gap.

potential_missed_opportunities.title: Polyphonic digital-OR ecosystem data/analytics whitespace
potential_missed_opportunities.what_happened: J&J MedTech is deploying its Polyphonic open digital ecosystem with AWS, NVIDIA and Core42 to build an emirate-wide intelligent surgical network with Abu Dhabi DoH.
potential_missed_opportunities.evidence: Deploy J&J Polyphonic open digital ecosystem with AWS, NVIDIA and Core42; emirate-wide intelligent surgical network.
potential_missed_opportunities.ai_hypothesis: A connected AI-enabled surgical data ecosystem signals a move into digital-health platforms needing data, analytics and integration expertise beyond device sales.
potential_missed_opportunities.so_what: Digital OR networks create new data/software workstreams J&J will need partners to scale globally.
potential_missed_opportunities.why_it_matters_to_indegene: Aligns with DAAI and Tech Solutions for data integration, analytics and platform enablement; risk of missing a new non-brand revenue stream if not pursued.
potential_missed_opportunities.next_best_action: Explore a DAAI/Tech Solutions role extending Polyphonic to additional geographies and analytics use cases.
potential_missed_opportunities.if_no_action: The partners already inside the Abu Dhabi deployment absorb the analytics and integration work, and the whitespace converts into their roadmap instead of Company's. A new non-brand revenue stream then forms without Company anywhere in its data layer.
potential_missed_opportunities.why_now: The emirate-wide deployment is live, so data and analytics roles in the ecosystem are being allocated now rather than later.
potential_missed_opportunities.nba_outcome: A DAAI or Tech Solutions pilot scoped within the Polyphonic ecosystem.
potential_missed_opportunities.expected_outcome: An analytics or integration role secured in the ecosystem's expansion roadmap, with Company named in the partner map before the whitespace is claimed.

potential_missed_opportunities.title: ROI-measurable engagement hedge against MFN/tariff pressure
potential_missed_opportunities.what_happened: J&J received White House MFN pricing letters and committed $55B+ to US manufacturing with tariff suspension tied to onshoring.
potential_missed_opportunities.evidence: J&J among 17 manufacturers receiving MFN pricing letters; committed $55B US manufacturing; three-year tariff suspension tied to onshoring/MFN.
potential_missed_opportunities.ai_hypothesis: Pricing and tariff pressure push J&J to demonstrate value and optimize commercial efficiency, favoring data-driven, cost-effective engagement.
potential_missed_opportunities.so_what: Policy headwinds squeeze margins, raising the ROI bar on commercialization spend.
potential_missed_opportunities.why_it_matters_to_indegene: An efficiency mandate favors Company's analytics-led, outcome-measurable models — but only if positioned proactively before budgets tighten.
potential_missed_opportunities.next_best_action: Position DAAI-led, ROI-measurable engagement as a hedge against pricing and tariff margin pressure.
potential_missed_opportunities.if_no_action: Budgets tighten before Company demonstrates its ROI-measurable model, and efficiency reviews cut commercialization spend Company was never positioned to protect. The hedge then never takes effect because it was framed after the squeeze.
potential_missed_opportunities.why_now: MFN letters and the tariff-suspension deal are current policy facts, and the efficiency review cycle they trigger is underway now.
potential_missed_opportunities.nba_outcome: ROI-measurable engagement terms embedded in current J&J contracts before the margin reviews begin.
potential_missed_opportunities.expected_outcome: Company scopes carry measurable-ROI structures that survive efficiency reviews, with the hedge framed in the current planning cycle.
